## Lead

Commercial property insurers raised renewal rates for coastal accounts for the third straight quarter, while capacity for inland risks loosened. Brokers say the split now shapes most mid-market placements: buyers with coastal exposure are carving it out into separate towers, and everyone else is getting broader terms at flat pricing. ([Example Wire](https://news.example.com/property-renewals))

The quarter's reinsurance data backs that up. Catastrophe bond spreads tightened again, and two large carriers said they would grow their property books in the second half if pricing holds. ([Example Markets](https://markets.example.com/cat-bonds-q3))

## Market pulse

- **Insurance index** closed the week up 1.8%, ahead of the broader market, led by specialty carriers. ([Example Markets](https://markets.example.com/index-week))
- **Reinsurers** gained 2.4% after a quieter hurricane forecast for the rest of the season. ([Example Wire](https://news.example.com/reinsurers-rally))
- **Brokers** slipped 0.6% as organic growth guidance softened at two of the largest firms. ([Example Markets](https://markets.example.com/broker-guidance))
- **Ten-year yields** rose 9 basis points, which lifts expected investment income on new money. ([Example Rates](https://rates.example.com/ten-year))
- **Catastrophe bonds** returned 1.1% for the month, the best September in five years. ([Example Markets](https://markets.example.com/cat-bond-returns))

## Earnings and filings

- **Northwind Mutual** reported a combined ratio of 91.4%, two points better than a year ago, on lower catastrophe losses and steady auto pricing. ([Example Filings](https://filings.example.com/northwind-q3))
- **Harbor Specialty** raised full-year premium growth guidance to 12% and announced a share buyback of 300 million. ([Example Filings](https://filings.example.com/harbor-q3))
- **Summit Re** took a reserve charge of 85 million on older casualty years, its second in three quarters. ([Example Filings](https://filings.example.com/summit-reserves))
- **Lakeside Life** filed to sell a closed block of annuities to a private capital buyer. ([Example Filings](https://filings.example.com/lakeside-annuities))

## Headline roundup

- **Auto claims** costs rose 6% year over year as repair labor and parts prices kept climbing. ([Example Wire](https://news.example.com/auto-claims))
- **Cyber insurance** take-up among small businesses reached 38%, up from 31% two years ago, according to a broker survey. ([Example Research](https://research.example.com/cyber-smb))
- **Flood program** renewal passed a committee vote, keeping the federal program running through next September. ([Example Policy](https://policy.example.com/flood-renewal))
- **Wildfire models** were updated by two vendors to include ember spread, which raises modeled losses in parts of the West. ([Example Research](https://research.example.com/wildfire-models))
- **Workers' comp** rates fell again in most states, the tenth year of declines. ([Example Wire](https://news.example.com/comp-rates))
- **Title insurers** reported a pickup in refinance orders after mortgage rates dipped in August. ([Example Wire](https://news.example.com/title-orders))

## Deal flow

- **Crestline Partners** agreed to buy a regional broker with 140 million in revenue, its fourth deal this year. ([Example Deals](https://deals.example.com/crestline))
- **Bluewater Holdings** raised 250 million in a sidecar to write property catastrophe reinsurance for the 2027 renewals. ([Example Deals](https://deals.example.com/bluewater-sidecar))
- **Meridian Insurance** sold its personal lines unit to focus on commercial specialty. ([Example Deals](https://deals.example.com/meridian-sale))
- **Atlas Underwriting** closed a Series B of 60 million to expand its small commercial platform. ([Example Deals](https://deals.example.com/atlas-series-b))

## Regulation and rates

- **State regulators** proposed a model rule on the use of third-party data in pricing, with comments due in December. ([Example Policy](https://policy.example.com/data-model-rule))
- **Florida** approved average homeowners rate decreases for three carriers, the first cuts in years. ([Example Policy](https://policy.example.com/florida-rates))
- **California** finalized its rule allowing catastrophe models in ratemaking, tied to writing commitments in high-risk areas. ([Example Policy](https://policy.example.com/california-models))
- **Capital standards** for international insurers moved a step closer after a supervisors' meeting in Basel. ([Example Policy](https://policy.example.com/capital-standards))

## People moves

- **Dana Whitfield** joins Harbor Specialty as chief underwriting officer from a larger rival. ([Example Wire](https://news.example.com/whitfield))
- **Marcus Ortega** will retire as chief executive of Summit Re next spring; the board named a successor from inside. ([Example Wire](https://news.example.com/ortega))
- **Priya Raman** was appointed head of cyber at Northwind Mutual. ([Example Wire](https://news.example.com/raman))

## Product and tech launches

- **Atlas Underwriting** launched same-day quotes for small contractors in 14 states. ([Example Tech](https://tech.example.com/atlas-quotes))
- **Clearpath Claims** released a photo estimating tool for auto glass that it says cuts cycle time by a day. ([Example Tech](https://tech.example.com/clearpath))
- **Ledger Re** opened a parametric flood product for small businesses, paying on river gauge readings. ([Example Tech](https://tech.example.com/ledger-parametric))

## Coming up

- **October 30**: Harbor Specialty and Summit Re report third-quarter results.
- **November 4**: State regulators' fall meeting opens, with the third-party data rule on the agenda.
- **November 12**: January reinsurance renewal pricing indications from the major brokers.
- **November 18**: Flood program vote in the full chamber.
